```kotlin:app/src/main/java/com/example/imageloader/loaders/ImageLoader.kt
class ImageLoader(context: Context, private val imageUrl: String) : Loader<Bitmap?>(context) {
 // Implementation details
}
```

Your `ImageLoader` class needs to extend `Loader<Bitmap?>`, not just implement it. This aligns with the return type expected in the `onCreateLoader` method. The error happens because the method is supposed to return a `Loader<Bitmap?>` type, but your current implementation returns something that doesn't properly extend this class.

Make sure your ImageLoader class has the correct inheritance and implements the necessary Loader methods (loadInBackground, onStartLoading, etc.)."}]}

The error occurs because your `onCreateLoader` method is returning `ImageLoader` directly, but it should return a `Loader<Bitmap?>` according to the interface.

Here's the fix:

```kotlin:app/src/main/java/com/example/imageloader/MainActivity.kt
// Called when a new loader needs to be created
override fun onCreateLoader(id: Int, args: Bundle?): Loader<Bitmap?> {
 Log.d(TAG, "onCreateLoader called for ID: $id")
 // Set loading status here as well, in case restartLoader didn't immediately trigger UI update
 binding.statusTextView.text = getString(R.string.status_loading)
 val url = args?.getString(URL_KEY) ?: "" // Safely get URL from args
 return ImageLoader(this, url) // Return a new instance of our loader
}
```

The issue is that the method signature in the `LoaderManager.LoaderCallbacks` interface specifically requires returning `Loader<Bitmap?>`, not just `ImageLoader`. While `ImageLoader` likely extends `Loader<Bitmap?>`, you need to explicitly declare the return type as specified in the interface."}]}
